name: Federico Ricchiuto
title: Full-Stack Developer
summary: Full-stack developer with over ten years building web applications, from consultancies serving multinational clients to my own practice for product companies. I work from the data model up — schema, domain logic, APIs, interface — and own the deployment pipelines that ship it. Recent engagements span a manufacturing enterprise platform, a healthcare API layer and a health-fund CRM modernized onto AWS, delivered in English with distributed teams.
highlight: Relocating to the Greater Toronto Area.

experience.summary: Run my own consulting practice, delivering backend and full-stack work for product companies in manufacturing, healthcare, publishing and logistics. Take projects from data model to production, including the deployment pipelines that ship them.

clients.name: BKT Tires — Manufacturing
clients.text: Delivered new features, refactored legacy modules and raised test coverage on the multi-tenant enterprise platform of a global tire manufacturer, used daily by internal teams across Europe, North America and Asia and by its B2C reseller network.

clients.name: Kalpa — Healthcare
clients.text: Designed and built the REST API layer of a healthcare application, with token-based authentication and a documented API contract the frontend team could use to work independently.

clients.name: Heveloon — Health Fund CRM
clients.text: Modernized a legacy CRM managing fund members and their payments. I replaced the authentication system end to end, introduced role-based access control across the platform, built batch processes for bulk payment runs, and moved document storage and the database onto encrypted AWS services.
clients.stack: Laminas (ex Zend), PHP, AWS S3 + KMS, Aurora, Lambda, ECS, SQS, SNS, Docker, Ext JS

clients.name: EmpireGroup — Sales Network CRM
clients.text: Developed a CRM tailored on customer's requests, for a multi-level sales network that grew from 5 agents to over 150 across agencies, divisions and teams. It dispatches appointments to the first available agent, calculates commissions, and gives each agent a personal calendar and dashboard to track their personal results.

clients.name: Other Engagements
clients.text: Delivered a digital newspaper distribution platform for a publishing group, a B2B/B2C marketplace, and a luggage pickup and delivery platform for the travel sector.

experience.summary: Maintained a master-data management platform used by a major insurance company, and prototyped a hybrid mobile app that captured data from identity and business documents via OCR.

Built and maintained backend and frontend of a mobile billing platform letting registered businesses sell services charged to end users' phone credit, with a role-based admin portal for refunds, subscriptions and account operations. Retained on the same engagement when NTT DATA hired me directly, across two and a half years working in English with teams distributed over Europe and Asia.
